patch_description: This version retains the current program’s stronger multi-order construction, lexicographic KVPR comparison, relocations, and memory-feasible swaps. It simplifies candidate evaluation by updating only the affected GPU pressures instead of repeatedly copying complete state arrays. It also adds the inspiration program’s pressure-first behavior as an additional construction order and performs a bounded best-improvement search that prioritizes minimizing the maximum KVPR while using the complete sorted pressure profile to break ties. This preserves the original function interface, return type, infeasibility behavior, and executable test harness.
